card.name: The word used in risk conditions
card.fires_on: The word use or used (sometimes given, it, patient) inside a list of risk conditions or co-administration clauses in drug warnings, just before words like concomitantly, on, under or for.

modes.description: The verb used or given after a drug name in a risk clause, before concomitantly.

modes.description: The noun use repeated in a list of factors that raise skin-steroid absorption.

modes.label: Other repeated subject words
modes.description: Words such as it, patient or patients that restate a subject or object in a clause.
modes.example: Elderly patients and<< patients>> with a prior history of peptic ulcer
